segments.text: So, when this real nature is held by such a yogi, for him, siddha sattantrabhaha, the state of absolute independence, sattantrabhaha means, the state of absolute independence is already achieved, siddha means, it is already achieved by such a yogi.
Siddha means, sampana, sampana means achieved, sattantrabhaha, absolute independence. And that absolute independence lies in all knowledge, all action and all will.
So, by this absolute independence, asesh, vishi, vashikari sattantrabhaha, in reality, this is that sattantrabhaha which makes this whole universe dependent to him.
This whole universe is lying at his disposal, at the disposal of such a yogi. This whole universe is lying at his disposal.
Whatever he does, whatever he will take place in this universe.
Yaduhtam tri si nath padai. This is already said by tri nath padai was a great yogi.
Shreya saatantra shakti msaam saashikali paras marata. You must own that energy of absolute independence, which is really the energy of Bhairava.
In sachandha also, it is said, sarvatattani bhutani, mantra varnas, chie smnata, nittam tasya vashas, devai, shivava, naya, sada.
As he is always residing in finding out the reality of Shiva, such a yogi. For him, all the elements, all the elementary world, all individuals, all words, all sentences.
The sentences are absolutely dependent at his disposal. Whatever he does, whatever he reveals, will do and undo.
